annotations.title: Move an applicant to a stage

description: Moves an application to APPLIED, SCREENING, INTERVIEW, OFFERED, HIRED or REJECTED. For most stages the candidate receives the standard Jobiba status email, as in the ATS dashboard. An application the candidate withdrew cannot be moved. An optional note is added to the team's internal notes on the applicant (the candidate never sees it); a note with no status moves nobody and emails nobody.

note.description: Internal note for the hiring team, up to 1,000 characters. Never shown to the candidate.

name: update_applicant_status
